tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The page itself. Arena (dark) is the default theme — sport is watched at night.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, score cards, tables, the nav bar.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells inside a surface: crest placeholders, rank 4+ badges, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for secondary and ghost buttons and clickable cards.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card borders, table row dividers. Decorative only — never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (secondary button) and the trailing segment of a StatBar. ≥3:1 on ground and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the logo's bars, on ground, surface, surface-sunken and podium-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, table headers, the losing side of a final score. ≥4.5:1 on ground, surface and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: podium
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary action, active tab bar, the leading StatBar segment, links. As text, on ground, surface or podium-soft.

tokens.name: podium-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of the primary button.

tokens.name: podium-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind podium text: the followed-team row, podium badges.

tokens.name: on-podium
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a podium fill (primary button label).

tokens.name: brand-violet
tokens.usage: The logo's winner dot and the app-icon field only. Not a UI colour — UI uses podium.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Rank 1 fill. A fill only, never text; label it with on-medal.

tokens.name: silver
tokens.usage: Rank 2 fill. A fill only, never text; label it with on-medal.

tokens.name: bronze
tokens.usage: Rank 3 fill. A fill only, never text; label it with on-medal.

tokens.name: on-medal
tokens.usage: The numeral on gold, silver and bronze (≥8:1 on each).

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: LIVE status only — never errors, never decoration. As text, on surface or live-soft.

tokens.name: live-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind the LIVE badge.

tokens.name: win
tokens.usage: W in form guides, positive deltas. As text, on surface or win-soft. Losses are ink-muted, not red.

tokens.name: win-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind win badges.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px podium outline, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links and SectionHeader actions.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per screen at most: hero moments, the champion.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Screen titles on phones, story headlines.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: Scores and big stats. Always with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Competition names, table headers. Set uppercase in CSS.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: A late equaliser sends it to extra time.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, team names in lists.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Most layouts use space-2, space-4 and space-6.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between StatBar segments, icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside badges, table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Rows inside a card; table cell horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; phone screen side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding; gap between tabs.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between major blocks on large layouts.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero padding.

radius.note: Podium is square-shouldered, like the blocks in the mark. Round only the live dot and avatars.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: The mark, StatBar segments, the active tab bar.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, crests, rank badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets. The largest radius in the system.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Live dot, nav winner-dot, player avatars.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons in dense tables (add 6px invisible hit area).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button height — the minimum touch target.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Full-width primary actions on phones.

shadow.note: Surfaces separate by colour and hairlines first; shadow only for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Sheets, menus, the floating live-score pill.
